fato_historico: 1868: Cornell University holds opening day ceremonies; initial student enrollment is 412, the highest at any American university to that date.
energia_do_dia: Today carries the steady energy of beginnings and growth. Much like the historic moment when a great university opened its doors to hundreds of eager souls, you may find that starting a new project brings immense potential. It is a good time to consider the long-term impact of your current ambitions and lay a solid foundation for your future success.
frase_do_dia: Great things grow from the steady efforts we plant in the fertile soil today.
significado_numero: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and the structure of your personal growth.
conselho: Focus on the details of your vision and trust in your slow, steady progress.
